Name: Fruit Tree Starter
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod was created with the goal of making the early stages of the game a little easier.[/b][/size]

After the game begins, an event will occur if you enter the farm on a sunny morning on or after the third day of play.
The fruit tree you selected from the event options will be sent to you via mail attachment the next day.

That's all.

[size=2]Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.[/size]
